notes.title: >>>Community Group Challenge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41930053/39c3ddd24569815ee2cb227d88197a0e7eddd931.png[/img]

Hello gamers!
Farm Manager World will hit Early Access on 29.04.2024!
However, you have a chance to lower this price! We have prepared a little challenge for Farmaniacs ❤️
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2206350/Farm_Manager_World/

By spreading the word about the game, you can unlock the launch discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41930053/0450ad8761ccb306ee051a0e91c384e4a62542c2.png[/img]
If our wishlist count hits 24 000, we will launch the game with a 6% discount.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41930053/19bcb558577fa67de3e03ff030c42a8196449650.png[/img]
If our wishlist count hits 26 000, we will launch the game with a 8% discount.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41930053/3d8db9c800e833359a6ccce6ffe209a7f60f59eb.png[/img]
If our wishlist count hits 30 000, we will launch the game with a 10% discount.

You can really help us out by adding Farm Manager World to your wishlist. It will improve our visibility on Steam, which is especially important on the launch day!

Thank You all for your patience and support during the development process. See you on the release day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41930053/c8edca37ae750d192f524c1b3f9f1880aad8bc1a.png[/img]
